description: In its recommendations, the article invokes Attachment Theory (citing Erozkan, 2009) to explain and address the social-anxiety component of foreign language speaking anxiety.
title: Attachment Theory account of social anxiety in language learning

description: The article introduces a framework intended to fill a guidance gap around attendance incentives.
title: A framework of design considerations for attendance incentives

description: Attribution Theory holds that a learner's motivation after success or failure depends less on what actually caused the outcome than on what the learner believes caused it, classified along the dimensions of locus, stability, and controllability.
title: Attribution Theory
